scientific_integrity: All-size proof is given through simplex volume and a monotone covariance factor. The standalone verifier independently reconstructs the bivariate mass function and tests exact rational identities, finite sign regions, and scaling. No claim of independent audit or formal certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite-sample phase theorem for uniform circular one-step spacings, not nonuniform or higher-order spacings. The known Gaussian-process limiting covariance and Dirichlet simplex identity are explicitly not asserted as new; incomplete access to several older primary papers leaves historical-priority risk.
title: A sharp finite-sample sign phase diagram for two-scale uniform spacing exceedances
